description: Test suite for server limits and user management in Mattermost, including license enforcement, user count limits, post history limits, and guest tracking.

methods.name: TestGetServerLimits
methods.description: Tests for retrieving server limits under various license and user scenarios.

methods.name: TestIsAtUserLimit
methods.description: Tests for checking if the server is at the user limit, considering license enforcement and user counts.

methods.name: TestExtraUsersBehavior
methods.description: Tests for behavior of extra user limits based on license configuration.

methods.name: TestGetServerLimitsWithPostHistory
methods.description: Tests for post history limits and last accessible post time based on license and system variables.

methods.name: TestShouldTrackSingleChannelGuests
methods.description: Tests for determining if single channel guest tracking should be enabled based on license and config.

methods.name: TestGetServerLimitsWithSingleChannelGuests
methods.description: Tests for populating single channel guest limits when tracking is enabled.

methods.name: TestGetPostHistoryLimit
methods.description: Tests for retrieving post history limit under various license configurations.
